why: A checker finding against a frozen, hash-bound candidate is corrected as a CLAIM, not by rewriting the frozen commit: rewriting it would invalidate the independent receipt that is bound to those exact bytes and would let the maker silently absorb the checker's finding.

corrections.original_claim: README.md:114-115 states that --root is a GLOBAL option and must be placed before the subcommand.
corrections.measured: The claim is too broad. `project --root <root> --dry-run` and `export --root <root> --dry-run` both exit 0; cli.py declares subcommand-local --root options for those two verbs.
corrections.corrected_claim: --root must precede the subcommand for the documented compiler chain (init, intake, compile-pi, bind-pd, compile-ecp, compile-tqaep, validate) and for doctor; `project` and `export` additionally accept it after the subcommand.
corrections.action_taken: NOT rewritten in the frozen commit; carried as TT-S4R2-09 for the next revision so the independent receipt stays bound to 7c00b649.
corrections.what_is_not_claimed: No new receipt was issued for a corrected tree. The checker's PARTIAL/SCOPE_BOUNDED verdict stands against 7c00b649 as-is.

corrections.original_claim: The whole suite passes on the candidate.
corrections.measured: The orchestrator measured Ran 410 tests OK (skipped=3) in the WRITABLE worktree at the frozen commit. The checker correctly declined to run the suite ON the frozen read-only subject because the test tooling writes .pyc.tmp beside subject modules and temp files under ROOT/.hgk, which would violate its own no-mutation rule.
corrections.corrected_claim: Ran 410 tests OK (skipped=3) is a measurement on a writable checkout at commit 7c00b649, NOT on the pristine read-only subject. The pristine subject was verified byte-identical (1326 files, zero changes) but the suite was not executed against it.
corrections.action_taken: Stated precisely in the acceptance master; no claim of a suite run on the pristine subject is made.
corrections.what_is_not_claimed: No claim that the suite was run against the frozen subject itself.

corrections.original_claim: The README's compiler walk-through is literally copy-paste-able.
corrections.measured: The checker declined to execute the block verbatim (it names another checkout in PYTHONPATH and deletes a pre-existing TEMP directory) and instead ran an adjusted form in a private scratch dir, twice, reproducing hashes.
corrections.corrected_claim: The chain is runnable and deterministic under an adjusted invocation. A literal copy-paste of the exact block was not receipted by an independent party; the maker's lane and the orchestrator executed the documented commands with the pinned interpreter.
corrections.action_taken: Recorded as a residual on the documentation claim.
